role: Shareholder; chairman of the board (valdes priekšsēdētājs) as of 2022

period: board post declared in 2022; shareholding and dividends declared for 2025
detail: His 2022 candidate data and his 2022 declaration list a post in SIA VK Development (chairman of the board, per the candidate data). LETA reports from his declaration for 2025 that he held 200 shares with a total nominal value of 2,800 EUR, and TV3 that he received 10,000 EUR in dividends from the company in 2025. The reports do not describe the company's business, and the sources consulted do not say whether he kept the board post as Prime Minister. Rests on press reports citing his VID declaration, which could not be read for this research.
